title: Hurled Stones and the Fortress of Rights
summary: 'I will gather every stone hurled at me to build the fortress of Tamil rights', proclaimed Karunanidhi from the podium, turning physical violence into political resolve.
keywords: Hurled Stones and the Fortress of Rights
full_text:
From his earliest days as a teenage agitator, Karunanidhi commanded public platforms with mesmerizing oratorical brilliance. Threatened by his influence, opponents frequently attempted to disrupt his rallies with violence.

One evening in Madurai, a sea of thousands gathered to hear him speak.

Minutes into his speech, hired instigators in the rear began hurling fist-sized rocks and broken bricks toward the stage. A heavy jagged stone crashed onto the lectern, shattering the water glass and splashing water across Karunanidhi's white khadi shirt.

Panicked party cadres rushed to shield their leader:
"Kalaignar! Step down! They are throwing rocks! Your life is in danger!"

Karunanidhi refused to budge an inch.

He gently brushed aside his bodyguards, reached down, and picked up the jagged stone with his bare fingers. Holding it aloft in front of the microphone, he looked out across the tense gathering.

An eerie silence fell over the crowd.

Karunanidhi's voice rang out with thunderous defiance:
"Comrades! My warm greetings to the generous friends in the shadows who hurled this stone!
Behold: the weapon you cast at my chest rests firmly in my palm.
Did you truly imagine that M. Karunanidhi would flee like a coward at the sight of a stone?
The hand that penned *Parasakthi* is in these fingers; the chest hardened on the railway tracks of Kallakudi beats beneath this shirt!

Hear my solemn vow:
I shall not discard a single stone hurled at me.
I shall gather every rock, every brickbat, and every insult thrown my way.
Do you know why?
Because tomorrow, when we build the impregnable fortress of social justice and state autonomy for the Tamil people... I will use these very stones as the foundation blocks of that fortress!"

The crowd erupted in ecstatic roar: "Long live Kalaignar! Long live our leader!" The terrified assailants dropped their weapons and melted into the darkness.

Karunanidhi continued with a radiant smile:
"The flowers showered upon me I place upon my head in gratitude; the stones hurled at me I forge into a fortress of rights! As long as the love of the people protects me, no weapon on earth can shake my resolve!"
moral: Malice and physical hostility lose their power when met by an indomitable soul capable of converting insults into moral strength.

quiz.question: What did Karunanidhi proclaim when a hostile heckler threw a heavy stone at his podium?
options: He filed a police complaint and abandoned the rally
He picked up the stone and declared he would use every hurled stone to build the fortress of social justice
He ordered his cadres to retaliate with violence
quiz.hint: Karunanidhi famously neutralized physical intimidation by declaring he would build a fortress from the stones thrown at him.
